# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Feb 17, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing L2 contract management with batch upgrade capabilities, refining deployment processes, and improving CI/CD pipelines for greater efficiency and reliability.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### L2 Contract Management and Upgrades
*   The `L2ProxyAdmin` has been extended to support batch upgrades of L2 predeploy contracts via the xFork L2ContractsManager, significantly improving the upgrade process for L2 predeploys. ([#19135](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19135))
*   Improvements were made to how `DelayedWETH` addresses are loaded during fork-based upgrade tests, fixing several issues. ([#19206](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19206))

### Deployment Process Refinements
*   Default L1 and L2 Proxy Admin Owners (PAOs) have been removed, and related documentation has been relocated in preparation for the `docs.optimism.io` migration. ([#19166](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19166))

### CI/CD and Testing Improvements
*   The `reproducible-prestate` build process was adjusted to allow parallel building of `op-program` and `kona` prestates, and the full prestate build is now a CI dependency. ([#19184](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19184))
*   A new acceptance test was added for block-level throttling in the batcher. ([#19079](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19079))
*   The CI configuration was updated to only build the specified Rust binary, improving build efficiency. ([#19204](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19204))
*   The `cannon-kona-host` job was removed from CI as it is now built via the `kona-build-release` job. ([#19207](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19207))
*   A fix was implemented for the Devin client to prevent timeouts by correctly populating the `structured_output` field in the Devin API response. ([#19219](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19219))
*   Supernode's inner node shutdown now includes a 30-second context deadline to prevent test timeouts. ([#19213](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19213))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
*   **CI/Testing Enhancements:** Several PRs focus on improving CI and testing infrastructure, including running acceptance tests against the Rust stack ([#19222](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19222)), adding an interop FP trace extension action test to devstack ([#19221](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19221)), converting GovernanceToken tests to fuzz tests ([#19218](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19218)), enhancing LegacyMintableERC20 test coverage with fuzz tests ([#19215](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19215)), and parallelizing acceptance tests across CI nodes ([#19211](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19211)).
*   **Protocol and Engine Updates:** New PRs address executing NUT bundles at Karst fork activation ([#19220](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19220)) and adding a retry limit to prevent infinite task stalls in the engine ([#19216](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19216)).
*   **Supernode and Contracts:** A PR for Supernode/same timestamp interop has been opened ([#19217](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19217)), along with a feature to add Kailua Contracts and Boundless Support Part 3 ([#19210](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19210)).
*   **Acceptance Test Refinements:** A PR aims to flake-shake and promote acceptance tests ([#19214](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19214)).

## CLOSED ISSUES

### L2 Contract Management Upgrade
*   The issue regarding adding an `upgradePredeploys()` function to the L2 ProxyAdmin, which delegates to L2ContractsManager's upgrade function, has been closed. This functionality is now implemented and callable by the Depositor account. ([#18829](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18829))

## NEW ISSUES

### Docker Build Workflow Optimization
*   An issue has been opened to migrate the `op-deployer` Docker build from CircleCI to GitHub Actions, as it is the last remaining Docker image built on CircleCI. ([#19208](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19208))
*   Another issue highlights the need to optimize Docker build workflows in GitHub Actions, as all images are currently built on every qualifying commit regardless of changes, leading to wasted resources. ([#19209](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19209))

### Database Memory Leak in op-reth
*   A bug report details a memory leak in `op-reth` where the warning "The database read transaction has been open for too long triggers memory leak" appears, causing nodes to consume all available memory. ([#19212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19212))
